propositions: The outbound differ compares in vendor shape (raw Jira dicts) while the inbound differ compares in canonical shape (mapped local), creating an asymmetric architecture that violates the ADR 0035 seam principle.
The outbound diff path must be refactored to canonicalize the snapshot via InboundMapper before comparison and emit vendor payloads only via OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote at the boundary.

Neutral canonical-shape field comparison helpers must replace vendor-specific helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches) in core, with assignee/reporter identity dicts and remote_parent_id as canonical aliases.
The assignee resolver re-homed to OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee must preserve its 3-state contract (value, authoritative, is_account_id) while accepting only canonical assignee_identity shape.

Partial baseline dicts (BASELINE_FIELDS subset) must map via map_remote_to_local with presence-guarded emission (absent vendor key → absent canonical key, no defaults) while preserving full-snapshot byte-identity.
The outbound differ must contain no adapters.jira imports and no raw Jira snapshot key literals, verified by AST gate and denylist enforcement.
